# The flows that rivus finds in its own code (TestDogfood, ADR-037): (the function of the source -> the function that has the
# sink [the sink]), one line per finding. See checkDogfoodFlows (dogfood_test.go) for how to change this file.
#
# What the groups are (a command line is a source; what it names reaches the file and process operations of rivus: that is what a
# CLI does, and it is what the analysis must find in its own code):
#  - analyze: the paths of the flags reach os.Create (the output files, the profiles) and the extractor command.
#  - isolate.go (ADR-093): the directory of -C and the paths of -isolation-read reach os.ReadFile (Cargo.lock, the toolchain file, the cargo
#    configuration, the manifests). They are what the isolation is about: the project is untrusted, and the paths that name it are read by
#    rivus only to decide what to give the sandbox (the program it runs is in the Darwin view: dogfood-flows-darwin.txt). `rivus debug extract -lang rust`
#    (runExtract) reads the project the way analyze does, so it has the same flows.
#  - graph (ADR-059): graphIndexer's closure keeps the path of -o and applies it where it is made: the files graphdb.Write
#    creates. runVersion runs the extractor command that the flag names (exec.LookPath carries its argument: R-03, ADR-066).
#  - the directory of -C goes through the packages to the os.ReadDir of gossa.countTestFiles (ADR-062).

cmd/rivus.runAnalyze -> (*cmd/rivus.analyzeOpts).analyze [os.Create]
cmd/rivus.runAnalyze -> (*cmd/rivus.analyzeOpts).analyze [os.Create]
cmd/rivus.runAnalyze -> (*cmd/rivus.analyzeOpts).analyze [os.Create]
cmd/rivus.runAnalyze -> (*cmd/rivus.analyzeOpts).extractInto [os/exec.Command]  # the extractor command of -extractor (or -lang) is run: the same flow as extractRaw before the function was renamed
cmd/rivus.runAnalyze -> (*cmd/rivus.common).loadRules [os.Open]  # the rule files that the flags name (-rules, -rules-dir) are opened to be read: what the flags say reaches the file that rivus reads
cmd/rivus.runAnalyze -> (*cmd/rivus.common).projectRuleFiles [os.ReadDir]  # the directory of -C is listed to find the rule files of the project: the path of the project is what the flag says
cmd/rivus.runAnalyze -> cmd/rivus.cargoLockVersions [os.ReadFile]  # Cargo.lock in the directory of -C is read for the versions of the crates (summary.unverified_versions)
cmd/rivus.runAnalyze -> cmd/rivus.dartLockVersions [os.ReadFile]  # pubspec.lock in the directory of -C is read for the versions of the packages (summary.unverified_versions)
cmd/rivus.runAnalyze -> cmd/rivus.readIR [os.Open]
cmd/rivus.runAnalyze -> cmd/rivus.readIRSpill [os.Open]  # the file that holds the IR beside the run is opened to be read back (the spill of ADR-123; the path comes from the flags of the run): the same flow as readIR
cmd/rivus.runAnalyze -> internal/frontend/gossa.countTestFiles [os.ReadDir]
cmd/rivus.runAnalyze -> internal/graphdb.hashFile [os.Open]
cmd/rivus.runAnalyze -> internal/vcs.findGitDir [os.ReadFile]  # the .git file of the project (-C) is read to find the Git directory (a worktree has a file there): the path of the project is what the flag says
cmd/rivus.runAnalyze -> internal/vcs.readHead [os.ReadFile]  # HEAD, the refs and packed-refs of the Git directory of the project (-C) are read for the commit of the report: the path of the project is what the flag says
cmd/rivus.runAnalyze -> internal/vcs.readHead [os.ReadFile]  # HEAD, the refs and packed-refs of the Git directory of the project (-C) are read for the commit of the report: the path of the project is what the flag says
cmd/rivus.runAnalyze -> internal/vcs.readHead [os.ReadFile]  # HEAD, the refs and packed-refs of the Git directory of the project (-C) are read for the commit of the report: the path of the project is what the flag says
cmd/rivus.runAnalyze -> internal/vcs.readHead [os.ReadFile]  # HEAD, the refs and packed-refs of the Git directory of the project (-C) are read for the commit of the report: the path of the project is what the flag says

cmd/rivus.runExtract -> internal/frontend/gossa.countTestFiles [os.ReadDir]
